project_type: Google Apps Script (GAS) web app - single-page HTML with inline JS
build_system: None - single HTML file deployed to GAS via HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile()
build_command: N/A - no build step, single HTML file
test_command: N/A - open index.html in browser to visually verify
verification_instructions: 1. Open /projects/sandbox/timestamp/index.html in a browser to verify structure. 2. Check that no static <script src> tags remain in <head>. 3. Verify dynamic loader function exists and calls initApp(). 4. Verify logo position dropdown exists in the Logo card. 5. Verify VRF code renders in gold color center-right. 6. Verify camera fallback code uses getUserMedia for laptops.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - edit index.html directly
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No server-side testing available (GAS backend not present in sandbox). Validation is structural/AST-based only.
contribution_requirements: Work on feature/backend-cloud-icons branch. Single file changes to index.html.
key_patterns: Single IIFE pattern wrapping all app code. Uses var (ES5 compatible). State object holds all app state. Helper function $(id) wraps getElementById. renderOverlay() is the shared canvas drawing function. initLocation() initializes Leaflet mini-map. initPayment() handles QRIS QR code generation.
directory_structure: Flat structure: index.html (main app), Code.gs (GAS server), BackendService.gs (subscription backend), sw.js (service worker), manifest.json (PWA manifest), icon SVGs
